sources.file: Combustion of Solids in Microgravity Results from the.pdf
sources.assessment: Experimental presentation with plots/images; plotted output values not digitized in this pass.

sources.file: Confined Combustion of Polymeric Solid Materials in microgravity.pdf
sources.assessment: Experimental test matrix plus figures; no table of directly linked exact output values transcribed. Requires figure digitization, not trend-to-number conversion.

sources.file: Dynamics of flame spread over filter papers in microgravity aboard the ISS.pdf
sources.assessment: Two Figure 1A explicitly labeled slopes extracted. Run pressure and specimen width unresolved.

sources.file: Effects of Ambient Conditions on Concurrent-Flow Flame Spread over a wide thin solid in microgravity.pdf
sources.assessment: Numerical simulations with comparisons to prior Saffire data; do not count simulations or repeated literature data as new direct measurements.

sources.file: Effects of Confinement on Flame Spread in Microgravity.pdf
sources.assessment: Nine experimental SIBAL concurrent-flow spread rates manually raster-digitized from Fig. 7a; explicit nominal pressure/oxygen and 7 cm/s imposed flow. Separate baffle types and distances. Overlapping D=3 cm markers excluded.

sources.file: Effects of Confinement on Opposed-Flow Flame Spread over Cellulose.pdf
sources.assessment: Eleven SIBAL opposed-flow stage measurements manually raster-digitized from Fig. 13 using Table 1 flow settings. Stages share campaign dependencies; no repeated figures counted. Explicit nominal atmosphere; width discrepancy retained for review.

sources.file: Effects of oxygen concentration of oxidizer flow on laminar diffusion flame established over liquid fuel beds at microgravity.pdf
sources.assessment: Numerical liquid-fuel study; incompatible mechanism, no simulated values promoted to observations.

sources.file: Fire Safety in Space – Beyond Flammability Testing of Small.pdf
sources.assessment: Background/design and literature discussion. No additional unambiguous run-level numerical output rows extracted.

sources.file: Fire safety in space – Investigating flame spread interaction over wires.pdf
sources.assessment: Image-only ScienceDirect article preview; OCR recovered abstract/snippets/recommendations, not a full experimental table. Full article needed.

sources.file: Flame spread Effects of microgravity and scale.pdf
sources.assessment: Image-only ScienceDirect article preview; OCR recovered preview content. Overlaps Saffire campaigns; not counted as an independent dataset.

sources.file: Flame spread over thin circular PMMA rods.pdf
sources.assessment: 20 plotted experimental averages: two textual anchors preserved, 18 additional marker values vector-digitized. Diameters 0.5/1 mm kept separate; nominal 0/1 g, 21% O2, 1 atm. Publication metadata pending review.

sources.file: Numerical study of concurrent flow flame spread over thin solids in.pdf
sources.assessment: Simulation paper, used only for explicitly tabulated experimental Saffire I/II conditions (Table 1), with supplementary citation hashes. No numerical model outputs promoted to observations; conflicting IV/VI condition summaries not merged.

sources.file: Preliminary results from the saffire VI Experiment.pdf
sources.assessment: Five Table 1/2 samples extracted; output temperatures are at SFU outlet, not flame temperatures. Calorimetry is unsupported by current regression.

sources.file: Quiescent flame spread and extinction over acrylic sheets in microgravity at increased oxygen concentration.pdf
sources.assessment: SoFIE/RTDFS experimental curves with changing pressure/thickness; pointwise values require graph digitization and condition linkage. No invented graph coordinates.

sources.file: Results of Large-Scale Spacecraft Flammability Tests.pdf
sources.assessment: Three concurrent SIBAL records completed with nominal pressure/oxygen from Han et al. Table 1. Remaining silicone controls and opposed sample remain incomplete. No gravity-dependent fit for single-level SIBAL cohorts.

sources.file: Saffire A Novel Approach to Study of Spacecraft Fire Safety Using Un-Manned Spacecraft.pdf
sources.assessment: Experiment design/planning presentation. Planned test conditions are not completed experimental measurements.

sources.file: The Effect of Microgravity on Flame Spread over a Thin Fuel.pdf
sources.assessment: Four primary Appendix A tables fully transcribed, individual rows only; averages and duplicate Table II summaries excluded. Additional extinction brackets and secondary hypergravity table retained separately.

sources.file: can spreading flame over electric wire insulation in concurrent flow achieve steady propagation in microgavity.pdf
sources.assessment: One explicitly experimental spread rate extracted; nearby theoretical spread/length values excluded.

sources.file: the effect of gravity on flame spread over pmma cylinders.pdf
sources.assessment: Screened native text; further source-specific table or graph extraction required. No additional unambiguous run-level numeric outputs transcribed.
